title: IBM Broadcom BCM957800A 4-Port 2x10Gb SFP+ 2x1GbE RJ45 PCI Express 2.0 x8 High-Profile Ethernet Network Adapter

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The IBM Broadcom BCM957800A is a high-performance 4-port Ethernet network adapter featuring 2×10Gb SFP+ and 2×1GbE RJ45 interfaces. Designed for data centers and enterprise servers, it supports PCI Express 2.0 x8, offering low-latency, high-throughput connectivity for demanding network environments.

Key Features (Featured):

  • Model: BCM957800A (High-Profile

  • Brand: IBM / Broadcom

  • Ports: 2×10Gb SFP+ + 2×1GbE RJ45

  • Interface: PCI Express 2.0 x8

  • Form Factor: High-profile, server-grade adapter

  • Compatibility: Ideal for IBM servers, also compatible with various x86 platforms

  • Use Case: Virtualization, high-speed networking, mixed copper/fiber deployments

  • Advanced Features: TCP/UDP offloading, VLAN tagging, PXE boot support
